title: P01 — Restore standalone VideoML package wiring
description:
## Dispatch packet P01
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D01 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain, cli, player, stdlib
Primary paths: cli/src/cli.ts; package exports; renderer package exports. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Replace stale cross-repo relative imports with public @videoml exports; fix stdlib local path and exports pointing at absent storyboard files. Pack/install in a temporary clean consumer; do not publish. Preserve legacy input extensions through explicit migration aliases.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
npm pack of each package plus a clean-consumer CLI import and minimal still-frame render; no unresolved sibling path.

## Dependencies
None: first implementation packet.

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Resource prerequisite
Complete videoml-bd05c1 (P00). Follow initiative D16 for disk reservation and exclusive repository ownership. No dependency installation before primary grants the heavy-operation slot.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary accepted P01 after reviewing imports/compatibility exports, independently running lint (pass), isolated npm test (26/26) and package regression checks (3/3), and viewing real rendered images. Six tarballs installed in clean consumer; legacy/direct context and registry identity verified. Strengthened CLI smoke verifies RGB 32,64,96, rejects stale scratch directories, and generates current .videoml.xml plus legacy .babulus.xml with explicit dry-run. Artifacts /private/tmp/videoml-execution/p01-verified and p01-final. Existing dry-run fixture requires a pause/precreated segment directory; follow-up recorded for P15 rather than hiding it. Accidental parent install was non-destructively quarantined, not deleted. Free space remains ~11.3 GiB. No publication.
